metadata.title: @capgo/capacitor-inappbrowser
metadata.description: Native in-app browser for Capacitor with managed WebViews, native UI layering, private sessions, proxying, downloads, popups, and app messaging.

hero.tagline: Native in-app browser for Capacitor with managed WebViews, native UI layering, private sessions, proxying, downloads, popups, and app messaging.

blocks.text: gives Capacitor apps two browser paths:
for the system browser experience and
for a managed native WebView that your app can size, hide, message, script, proxy, and layer with Ionic UI.

Use it when the page needs more than a simple external browser: OAuth and checkout flows, embedded support portals, payment screens, video calls, document portals, interactive web apps, or any flow where your app needs native controls around live web content.
